name: Synthwave '85
note: The palette, in one machine-readable place. Every theme in this repo — the
Ghostty config, zsh, Neovim, VS Code, IntelliJ, the Chrome theme, the
wallpaper prompts — is this file, hand-written into each target's own
format. This is the file to change first; palette/update.sh then tells you
It does not list every colour those themes contain. Anything a theme
derives — the VS Code washes like #f92aad33, their opaque equivalents in
nvim's blend() — is computed from these and is not duplicated here.

ui.note: What the terminal itself is painted with, as in ghostty/config.

note: The sixteen ANSI colours, index 0-15. Note index 5: ANSI magenta is the
softer #e45ab1, not the #f92aad the foreground uses — same hue, less

backgrounds.note: Darkest first. `bg` is the one everything else sits on.

text.note: Brightest first. `comment` is also ANSI bright black.

note: The accents. `magentaAnsi` is the quieter ANSI 5 and is used by terminal
What each accent means, which is the part that has to stay the same
across targets for them to look like one theme rather than three that
rhyme. Values name a key in `neon` or `text`.
The subset the image prompts in wallpapers/ are allowed to use, in the
order they are listed to the model. #2a2139 appears only here — it is a
shadow mass for the illustrations, not a UI colour.
